name: Travel Diary
description: An 8-bar trip edit on your song: three flash cuts open it, the next shot breaks in through tall bars, wide bars and a growing window, and your line appears one word at a time on the beat.

inputs.label: Trip clips and photos
inputs.hint: 6-12 is ideal; mix wide views, faces and movement. Fewer are reused at different moments.

inputs.label: Your line about the trip
inputs.placeholder: AMK..toughest trek / in maharashtra / 2 days / trek / 6000 calories burnt

agentHints: Twelve slots: 3 half-beat flash cuts, shots of 8, 8, 4, 4, 3.5 and 2.5 beats, 3 closing flash cuts. Each of shots 2-5 breaks in through bars or a window over the shot before it, so put contrasting clips next to each other: bright against dark, wide against close, calm against motion. Open on the trip's best action moment; give the window (shot 5) the widest, calmest view. Your picks are the order clips are cast in (slots reuse clips when there are fewer than 12): put the opening action shot first. Write the line with '/' between its five phrases.
